memory_effect_source_inference.qualification: Inference from pinned source only, not a measured peak. Lazy preparation still becomes actual source reads at write. Source page cache, dirty output pages, framework allocations and writeback remain charged or host-visible in different scopes; no 2GiB full conversion fit, wall-time or hard host bound is established.
memory_effect_source_inference.removed_operation: For eligible BF16 matrices, no full F32 cast or BF16 requantization output/list allocations; original mapped storage is exposed as a byte view.

reviewed_guards: Explicit --jev-preserve-bf16 selection only; default branch retains original conversion. Exact Gemma4UnifiedModel name and conversion.gemma module are checked.
Explicit MOSTLY_BF16 output; local model; lazy enabled; no temp/eager/bigendian, QKV/expert fusion, FP8 route, root/text quantization_config.

Eligibility requires original BF16 multidimensional .weight, no _norm suffix, norm_shift==0. Original pinned modify_tensors still runs. Gemma4 inherited embedding handling truncates rows using tokenizer; other eligible actual dense matrices rename unchanged.
Eager helper refuses non-little-endian host, non-CPU, non-BF16, noncontiguous or fewer-than-two-dimensional tensors. No contiguous copy or float cast is introduced.

Each accepted matrix is checked for BF16 Inf/NaN using at most 2^19 words per mask iteration; nonfinite values refuse before that tensor writes. This is a narrower acceptance domain than upstream, avoiding its NaN quieting difference.
Raw uint8 byte shape doubles the final logical dimension. Original GGUF writer raw_dtypeBF16 restores logical shape and enforces expected tensor byte count; no alternate writer or C++ graph is used.
One-dimensional norms/scalars and generated F32 RoPE tensors stay on original conversion; a non-BF16 qtype selected for a raw candidate rejects rather than silently changing representation.
